definitions.gloss: consecutive holidays; series of days off; long weekend
definitions.explanation: A period of multiple consecutive days off from work or school, often including weekends combined with national holidays.

examples.japanese: {連休|れんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}して→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going on a trip using the consecutive holidays.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴールデンウィーク→ゴールデンウィーク：22760_goorudenwiiku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{連休|れんきゅう}だ。
examples.english: Golden Week is a long holiday period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三連休|さんれんきゅう}→三連休：18275_sanrenkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいる→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: Everywhere is crowded during the three-day weekend.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{連|れん} (continuous, consecutive) + {休|きゅう} (rest, holiday)

COMMON VARIATIONS:
- ⟦{三連休|さんれんきゅう}→三連休：18275_sanrenkyuu⟧ - three-day weekend
- {四連休|よんれんきゅう} - four-day weekend
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{連休|れんきゅう} - extended holiday period (like Golden Week)
- {飛|と}び{石|いし}{連休|れんきゅう} - split holidays (with a work day in between)

JAPANESE HOLIDAY PERIODS:
- ⟦ゴールデンウィーク→ゴールデンウィーク：22760_goorudenwiiku⟧ (GW) - Golden Week (late April to early May)
- ⟦お{盆|ぼん}{休|やす}み→お盆休み：22679_obonyasumi⟧ - Obon holidays (mid-August)
- ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧ - year-end/new year holidays
- シルバーウィーク - Silver Week (September)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連休|れんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ - to take consecutive days off
- {連休|れんきゅう}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ - during the holidays
- {連休|れんきゅう}⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧ - after the holidays end
